description: This file defines an abstract class 'RegexBasedAbstract' for route data generation in the FastRoute library, including methods for adding routes, generating route data, and handling regex patterns.

classes.name: RegexBasedAbstract
classes.description: An abstract class implementing core route data generation logic for FastRoute, handling static and variable routes, regex building, and chunk processing.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route, determining if it is static or variable, and delegates to the appropriate method.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns static routes and generated variable route data.

methods.name: generateVariableRouteData
methods.description: Generates route data for variable routes, processing in chunks.

methods.name: computeChunkSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of chunks for route processing based on an approximate size.

methods.name: isStaticRoute
methods.description: Checks if a route is static based on route data structure.

methods.name: addStaticRoute
methods.description: Registers a static route, throws exception if duplicate or shadowed.

methods.name: addVariableRoute
methods.description: Registers a variable route with regex and variables, throws exception if duplicate.

methods.name: buildRegexForRoute
methods.description: Builds regex pattern and variables array from route data parts.

methods.name: regexHasCapturingGroups
methods.description: Detects if a regex pattern contains capturing groups.
